subject: general
question: The chemical symbol of potassium is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**K.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The chemical symbol of potassium is K.**
 
• Potassium is a chemical element with the **symbol K and atomic number 19.**
 
• Classified as an** alkali metal, potassium is a solid at room temperature.**
 
• The term potassium arises from a material called Potash.<
